'''Igor Lomov''' ({{langx|ru|Игорь Серге́евич Ло́мов}}) (born 1956) is a [[Russian mathematician]], [[Professor (highest academic rank)|Professor]], [[Doctor of Science|Dr.Sc.]], a professor at the [[MSU CMC|Faculty of Computer Science at the Moscow State University]].<ref>[http://letopis.msu.ru/peoples/3941 Annals of the Moscow University]{{in lang|ru}}</ref>

He defended the thesis «Mathematical modeling and computer analysis of liquid metal systems» for the degree of [[Doctor of Science|Doctor of Physical and Mathematical Sciences]] (2009).<ref>[http://en.cs.msu.ru/persons/1056 MSU CMC]{{in lang|ru}}</ref>

Author of 13 books and more than 90 scientific articles.<ref>[https://istina.msu.ru/profile/lomovIS/ Scientific works of Igor Lomov]</ref><ref>[http://www.mathnet.ru/php/person.phtml?&personid=17511&option_lang=eng Scientific works of Igor Lomov]{{in lang|en}}</ref>
